cards.name: Rivercourse Cold Water Conservation & Youth Fly Fishing Camp
cards.description: Campers learn fly fishing and fly tying, participate in conservation projects, and study stream ecology, water safety and insect life. The six-day residential program also includes falconry, outdoor games and conservation talks.
